messages:
sam-support: FYI escalating — ACME (acct acme-prod) reported intermittent 503s on /v1/generate last night, spike in latency, and an unexpected invoice charge. They've looped an external auditor asking for SOC2 evidence around retention and KMS usage. can we triage?

maria-sec: thanks for flagging. can you paste the error patterns? 503s + billing note is weird together. did they hit a rate-limit retry loop? :thinking_face:

sam-support: Logs show errors like:
```
ERROR 2026-11-02T03:12:45Z RequestHandler - downstream inference 503: model_unavailable (Retry-After: 30)
WARN 2026-11-02T03:12:50Z PaymentService - invoice_calculation: discrepancy detected for acct=acme-prod amount=+$120.00
```
They say latency tail went to 3s for token generation for ~2% of requests between 03:10-03:20 UTC. Repro steps attached in ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/ACME-4392

oliver-eng: I pulled the runtime traces — saw a small window where the dedicated pool hit warmup + model-variant fallback causing 503s. batching backlog + GPU OOMs triggered some model fallbacks. i'll paste trace snippet.

oliver-eng: ```
trace_id=tx-9a7f
node=dedicated-gpu-12
event=kvcache-miss
latency_ms=3120
fallback_to_cpu=true
error=503
```

jenna-privacy: auditor wants evidence for retention and key usage for that timeframe (03:00-04:00 UTC). They asked for:
- access log slice for acme-prod (API auth + request_ids)
- KMS/HSM audit logs for key rotations or accesses
- S3 object retention metadata and chain-of-custody export steps

auditor-bob: @maria-sec hi — we need the exact playbook to reproduce the incident for evidence purposes, plus the retention proof. specifically: which logs you will export, where we can download, and estimated delivery. Also clarify retention_policy applied to keystore logs and any sampling.

maria-sec: @auditor-bob understood. initial plan: export API gateway logs + internal request logs (slice by acct=acme-prod and request_ids from trace), export keystore audit logs from HSM proxy (keystore-audit-bucket), and provide a manifest with S3 object headers showing x-amz-restore/retention info. delivery estimate: 48 hours for full export, 6 hours for an interim sample. is that acceptable?
auditor-bob: 48h ok but need interim sample now. please include hashes for chain-of-custody and steps to verify integrity.

sam-support: interim sample requested by ACME as well. can we provide a minimal repro bundle (1) raw API logs for 03:10-03:20 UTC, (2) the model fallback events, (3) invoice calc trace for the billing anomaly?

oliver-eng: I can assemble the log slice. command I used:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-internal-logs/API/2026-11-02/2026-11-02_03-10-03-20.gz - | zcat | jq 'select(.acct=="acme-prod")' > /tmp/acme_api_slice.json
```
I'll also export model runtime traces from /var/log/serving/trace_tx-9a7f.log

maria-sec: for HSM/KMS — keystore logs are archived to s3://redwood-keystore-audit/ and we store signed manifests at s3://redwood-keystore-manifests/. retention_policy for those objects is "keep-7y-immutable" for audit archives, but recent live logs have 90d. we need to confirm which bucket contains the HSM proxy audit that covers key access (it should be keystore-audit/2026-11-02/). oliver, can you confirm presence and generate sha256 sums?

oliver-eng: confirming now. found objects:
- s3://redwood-keystore-audit/2026-11-02/hsm-proxy-03-12.log.gz
- s3://redwood-keystore-manifests/2026-11-02/manifest-hsm-03-12.json.sig
I'll run `shasum -a 256` and upload a verification.txt to the manifests folder.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout redwood/serving-runtime v3.9.2 -> v3.9.3 scheduled for 2026-11-03T02:00:00Z (canary=10%).

jenna-privacy: quick privacy check — ACME's auditor will see auth and request identifiers; redact PII (auth tokens) before export unless ACME signed a data access waiver. sam, did ACME grant permission?

sam-support: ACME signed the standard auditor access form and attached it to the ticket. I'll attach it to the export bundle too.

auditor-bob: for chain-of-custody, please provide: export manifest (list of objects), sha256 hashes, who executed export (s3 username), timestamp, and an HSM-signed manifest if available. also include the retention policy docs that applied on 2026-11-02.

maria-sec: acknowledged. action items:
- oliver: produce log slice + sha256s + runtime traces (ETA 2h)
- oliver: generate manifest file and upload to s3://redwood-keystore-manifests/acme-prod/ACME-4392-interim/ (ensure ACL restricted)
- jenna: confirm data redaction status and copy of signed auditor waiver (ETA 1h)
- sam: notify customer of interim sample availability and expected full export timeline (48h)

oliver-eng: started exports now. putting interim artifacts under s3://redwood-keystore-manifests/acme-prod/ACME-4392-interim/ with object keys: logs.json.gz, traces.tar.gz, keystore-hashes.txt. will post links when uploaded.

sam-support: thanks. ACME also asked about the billing anomaly — can finance look? cc @maria-sec if it ties to retry billing.

maria-sec: finance pinged. they requested the invoice calculation trace id. oliver, can you include the invoice service logs for tx-9a7f in the bundle?

oliver-eng: included. uploaded interim bundle. links:
- https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-keystore-manifests/acme-prod/ACME-4392-interim/logs.json.gz
- https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-keystore-manifests/acme-prod/ACME-4392-interim/traces.tar.gz
- https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-keystore-manifests/acme-prod/ACME-4392-interim/keystore-hashes.txt

auditor-bob: received. I see the manifest includes sha256s and uploader identity — good. two quick clarifications: 1) how were the hashes generated (toolchain), 2) is there any sampling applied to the API logs or is this full slice?

oliver-eng: hashes via `sha256sum` on the nodes, then verified with `aws s3api head-object --query ETag` for upload integrity. API logs slice is full for the period and acct filter (no sampling).

jenna-privacy: auditor waiver uploaded to ticket and attached to s3 manifest folder as waiver.pdf.

sam-support: to wrap up — i'll email ACME+auditor with the interim link and ETA for full package. maria, if SOC2 team signs off on manifest format i'll coordinate the 48h full export.

maria-sec: sounds good. one more: auditor asked whether we can reproduce the invoice discrepancy in a replay environment. we can provide a sanitized replay with anonymized keys in a staging account if they need repro steps. need approval from legal for replay data though. jenna, can you advise?

jenna-privacy: legal ok in principle for sanitized replay. require data minimization and an NDA addendum if external auditors will access staging. i'll start that now.

auditor-bob: thanks all. interim sample looks consistent with our needs. will review and follow up with any more asks within 24h. appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

sam-support: closing loop here, will update ticket and mark thread resolved once full export delivered. thanks team!
